title: Role-closed portable view replay for isolated local Staging databases

phases.objective: Make schema-only view replay portable across the three isolated local Staging database roles without SET USER, root replay, cross-role grants, Production access, or provider mutation.

e2e_journeys.actor: Governed Local Windows Staging recovery operator
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Clone-StagingDatabases.ps1 receives exact-SHA schema-only bundles generated from the disposable staging_schema_build database.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Role-local views are replayed only with their owning database objects, true cross-role views are excluded from isolated replay with evidence, the disposable builder qualifier is removed, DEFINER is rebound to CURRENT_USER, and the verified non-root importer completes exact object readback.
steps: Validate the original schema bundle and compute an offline role replay plan without connecting to any database or provider.
Discover final MariaDB view definitions and resolve their disposable-builder dependencies recursively across Runtime, Governance, and Runtime Persistence ownership.
Topologically order role-local views, remove temporary mariadb-dump view stubs, and exclude views whose dependency closure spans more than one isolated role.
Remove staging_schema_build qualifiers and replace explicit dump account DEFINER tokens with CURRENT_USER without granting SET USER or switching replay to root.
On apply only, emit temporary prepared schema-only bundles plus provenance while preserving the original generated bundles and checksums.
Invoke the previously verified importer engine against the prepared bundles using the configured non-root Staging identities and the existing canonical seed/readback lifecycle.

Copy schema-import-state.json back to the canonical dump directory, persist role-schema-replay-plan.json evidence, remove only the temporary replay workspace, and keep the portable manifest generated from the official writer.
assertions: The planner performs no Docker, MariaDB, Production, provider, Hostinger, Cloudflare, grant, or database mutation calls.
The plan is bound to the exact source commit and original bundle checksums.
Runtime-only views remain Runtime, Governance-only views move to Governance, and view-on-view dependencies are ordered before their consumers.
A view spanning Runtime and Governance dependencies is excluded from isolated replay rather than receiving cross-database authority.
Prepared SQL contains neither staging_schema_build qualifiers nor explicit root/account DEFINER tokens.
SET USER grants, root schema replay, broad schema grants, and cross-role grants remain forbidden.
Dry-run performs planning and legacy validation without prepared-file generation or database mutation.
Apply reuses the verified non-root importer and preserves canonical recovery state and existing reversible database backups.
The official portable-manifest writer includes the wrapper runtime dependencies needed for local recovery.
production_mutation_allowed is false and secrets_included is false.
